phrases.text: Amendment 1 covers the Lieutenant Governor, and legislative pay and travel.
Today, a Lieutenant Governor vacancy generally lasts until the next regular election for that office.
A vacancy more than 60 days before the next general election for state officers would require an election.
The Legislature would set pay for the Lieutenant Governor and legislative officers.
Legislative travel spending would need a legislative officer's approval.
Alabama's ballot statement says there are no costs or taxes.
A Legislative Services Agency fiscal note estimates $100,000 in proclamation expenses for the 2027 state fiscal year.
That note covers only the election.
Alabama publishes no official argument for the amendment.
Alabama publishes no official argument against the amendment.
A yes vote means the Alabama Constitution will be changed.
A no vote means the Alabama Constitution will not be changed.
